t: Talk to D2 Golem to receive the Folio of Knowledge, then use it to receive bonus experience.

Beep-beep!
Hurry, hurry and get your experience!
For one day only you have the opportunity to sample the Folio of Knowledge. This magical book doubles all your experience!
Don't delay! Beep-beep!

Congratulations!
You've received the Folio of Knowledge and can do anything you want with it!
I recommend reading it. Beep-beep!
Bring a Replica of Lesser Scroll of Sacrament to Goblin Banker at the Boutique Headquarters of your faction's capital.
Hmph... What a peculiar scroll copy. I should bring it to someone who deals a lot with unique wares... to Goblin Banker!
How can I be of help?

It's a copy of one of the lost scrolls!
The one who learns it will receive one extra talent point!
I can help you to understand what is written here.
Bring a Replica of the First Page from the Great Mage's Diary to Goblin Banker at the Boutique Headquarters of your faction's capital.

Replica of the First Page from the Great Mage's Diary... Ahem...
I should bring this rarity to Goblin Banker.
And I should free up some space in my bag, as the Goblin might reward me with something valuable... an additional Ruby!

What unbelievable luck! The Great Mage's Diary has been discovered!
Don't you know who the Great Mage was? It can't be true! Even Goblins know who the Great Mage is! He is a great hero of the past!
In the year 646 of the New Era he solved the mystery of Umoir and helped Skrakan defeat the great demon! See?
For years the diary was thought to be lost. And then this great news arrive! Unfortunately, the adventurers who found it didn't understand the true value of the document. Fools... They thought these papers were just dusty scrolls worth a couple of gold coins... But it is a priceless rarity! Oh, I wish I could have it...
I know that merchants put pages from the diary into Strongboxes of the Counselor. There are plenty of them! Anyone can buy them from the Boutique. I'm sure there's no way to find all the pages.
Oh, I wish someone would bring me a page or a copy of it! I would be so grateful!
Word of an honest goblin!

I can't believe my eyes!
It is a copy of a valuable item. Therefore, I give you your reward which you honestly deserved.
Bring a Replica of Common Jeweler Manuscript to Goblin Banker in the Boutique Headquarters of your faction's capital
Wow! It's a replica of Common Jeweler Manuscript! The manuscript teaches one how to equip a second earring. You'd better bring it to Goblin Banker.

Do you know that the ancient Junes were the greatest masters of gem cutting?
Just so you know - they could cut a full body armor out of a huge diamond! A soldier in such armor was nearly invulnerable.
Good news is that our masters managed to reproduce some of June works!
As you know, a person could only wear a single magic earring earlier, the second caused strong magical resonance, so they suppressed the powers of each other. But the secrets of Junes helped our jewelers to find a way to safely equip the second earring! Isn't it great?
Jewelers' knowledge is kept in the manuscripts that can be found in the Strongboxes sold from the Boutique.
If you manage to find the Common Jeweler Manuscript, bring it to me, and I'll teach you how to equip a second earring of the uncommon quality! I can also trade 10 Common Jeweler Manuscripts for an Experienced Jeweler Manuscript.

Now you can equip an additional earring of the uncommon quality.
Congratulations!
Bring Replica of Paragraph from The Study of Perfection to Goblin Banker at the Boutique Headquarters of your faction's capital.

It can't be! It's a Replica of Paragraph from The Study of Perfection found by Demon Hunters.
I should bring it to Goblin Banker at the Boutique Headquarters.

Wonderful news, indeed!
Demon Hunters managed to find the Study of Perfection scrolls that were lost after Cataclysm. There are rumors that Junes wrote them and this book was one of the guides studied by the Great Mages in the past. Can you imagine?
Hunters made a lot of copies to give everyone a chance to read it. Look for them in Radiant Strongboxes which can be bought from the Boutique.
If you find a page or its copy, bring it to me, I'll help you to decipher it.
What a find! You'll be glad that you waited to find the entire book. Let me help you decipher these ancient writings. Shall we start?
Bring the replica of the Scroll of the Wrathful Wizard to Goblin Banker at the Boutique.

The scroll is densely covered with runes, undecipherable spells, bizarre symbols and strange drawings.
If you look closely, you can recognize an image of some unknown emblem inspiring a sense of danger.
Perhaps Goblin Banker knows something about this scroll?
Good afternoon! How can I help you?

You managed to find a very rare scroll. These scrolls were written by a very powerful sorcerer in the times of the Conclave. He locked himself in a tower to carry out experiments, trying to combine offensive and protective charms in one amulet. And he succeeded!
Still, his last experiment was unlucky, the magician died and his tower was destroyed. But some of his records resurfaced recently. Now you can trade this scroll for one of the wizard's artifacts. Wear it with pride! It will surely help you in battles.
Take Water of Life and Water of Death from Golem D2.

Beep! Beep!

Hurry! This is your unique chance to reconsider everything!

Only today you can receive Water of Life and Water of Death, that will reset your stats and Talent points!

Do not pass me by!

Congratulations!

You've received Water of Life and Water of Death, and can do anything you want with them!

Think before you act, though.
Bring the Scroll of the Wrathful Wizard to Goblin Banker at the Boutique.

The scroll is densely covered with runes, undecipherable spells, bizarre symbols and strange drawings.
If you look closely, you can recognize an image of some unknown emblem inspiring a sense of danger.
Perhaps Goblin Banker knows something about this scroll?

The scroll is densely covered with runes, undecipherable spells, bizarre symbols and strange drawings.
If you look closely, you can recognize an image of some unknown emblem inspiring a sense of danger.
Perhaps Goblin Banker knows something about this scroll?
Good afternoon! How can I help you?

You've found a very rare scroll. These scrolls were written by a very powerful sorcerer in the times of the Conclave. He locked himself in a tower to carry out experiments, trying to combine offensive and protective charms in one amulet. And he succeeded!
Still, his last experiment got out of control; the magician died and his tower was destroyed. But some of his records resurfaced recently. Now you can trade this scroll for one of the wizard's artifacts. Wear it with pride! It will surely help you in battles.
Collect 700 Shards of a Frozen Tear of the Dragon by completing Yulia Dobrynina's quests or by opening Boxes of Tears of the Dragon from the Boutique.

Dragons are the Ancients of this world. They call themselves the Keepers of Sarnaut. There is hardly anyone they wouldn't kill willingly: whether it's a demon, or a human, or an animal. Hatred makes their eyes water, and the tears of loathing fall drip drop on the ground...
These tears conceal huge power. We have learned to use them for activating two especially destructive abilities, available to those who have reached a high level. Smaller tears are for sale, larger tears are rewarded for good deeds.
A Frozen Tear of the Dragon is as good as a common tear, perhaps even better - you can never run out of it, no matter how many times you use it. Every good deed you perform will grant you a shard of a Frozen Tear. Collect 700 of them, and I will fuse them into one.A Box of Dragon Tears is sold in the Boutique, if you prefer to obtain them faster!

Here it is. The magnificent Tear of the Dragon that has turned into a perfect, flawless crystal of eternal ice. Keep it safe, hero of Sarnaut. May be, some day you will be lucky enough to learn why they cry...

Find 25 pieces of magic dust and 25 pieces of magic ash. Use the Desorotype to take images of Oleg Pravdin, Oko the Righteous, Pavel Bogdanov, Yasskul Isis and Roman Lubyankin. Report to Elizabeta Rysina.

Ah-ha! I was just wondering whom would be a good fit for this important task... And here you are!
We need an update to our Hall of Fame. All candidates have already been chosen and approved, but we need their portraits to make it official! Tell me, have you ever heard of the "Desorotype?" It's a wonderful device that was created by the top minds at ZIT Headquarters and it has the ability to paint a portrait in less than a minute! Isn't that something?! I tell you, I just can't keep up with technology these days!
Anyway, for it to work, it needs two things - magic dust and ashes and you can find those components in the magic and fire elemental near Triumph Gate and Victory Park. After that, I'll need you to go take a "photo" of each of our candidates - Oleg Pravdin, Oko the Righteous, Pavel Bogdanov, Yasskul Isis, and Roman Lubyankin.
I know you're not going to do this for free, so how does an upgrade to your Steady Gaze sound? Ha ha! I knew you'd like that!
People must know their heroes! Desorotype will help to solve this issue.

Excellent. The quest is done.
I'll gladly teach you a new level of "Steady gaze". You deserve this reward by right.
Find 12 amulets of Smugglers from the Sewage Plant of Nezebgrad and bring them to agent Rysk the Crafty.

What's the difference between the agent of Nezeb's Committee and others?
He can see what is concealed! It's special ability which one can obtain only after years of training!
Ha, relax! I'm kidding! It's not so difficult.
Be attentive and be able to notice everything. Find what others want to conceal.
Let's take Smugglers living in the Sewage Plant. Do you know how they distinguish their guys? Due to a small amulet which they show only to their colleagues, so to say. It means: I'm in. Everything is ok.
It is not easy to find such amulet. Unprepared agent can't do it. Smugglers hide them safe. But if you manage to find them... You may call yourself the most attentive among all.

Smugglers are good at hiding illegal goods!
Search of their amulets is great experience for an agent.

Well!
My respect.
How do you feel? Now nothing can escape your gaze, ha!
Bring the Imperial State License to Yaver Yevgini in Nezebgrad Port to receive your Astral ship.

This license grants its holder the right to receive an Astral ship.
Bring it to Yaver Yevgini in Nezebgrad Port.
If you happen to find an Imperial State License, I will give you a completed Astral ship right away! All Empire veterans who come back to service are qualified for Astral travels.

In this hard times we need the aid of heroes more than ever! Brave captains will lead their ships through the Astral towards great victories!
We are glad that the veterans like you return to the ranks. The Empire believes in you!
Use the portable teleporter to the Kingdom of Elements and meet the Collector of Rarities.

Have you ever heard of the Kingdom of Elements?

It's an Astral isle recently discovered by a group of brave travelers who jumped into a previously unknown wormhole. It was a piece of land with some ruins and an old June portal. the travelers managed to activate it.

There was also a volcano in the middle of the isle that started erupting a few months ago and split the land apart. The cataclysm awakened elemental spirits that were sleeping in the depths. Many people were interested in this phenomenon, and soon first explorers, inlcuding the Collector of Rarities, an Overlord's servant, arrived to the Kingdom of Elements. Collector of Rarities is looking for those who can help him in his explorations. Remember, this place is dangerous. Aggressive elemental spirits are ready to incinerate, crush, or freeze anyone who steps into their territory. But if you're not afraid, you can gain invaluable experience and a hefty reward for your help in the research.
Did Sarbaz Harakhte send you here?

Kingdom of Elements represents a great opportunity for our research. Unfortunately, local elementals do not feel enthusiastic about it, that's why we need heroes like you to gather materials for research.
Visit horse breeder Vladimir Kostin in Nezebgrad and ask him about mounts' color patterns.

A letter that arrived at the post office makes mention of horse breeder Vladimir Kostin and his pedigree Steeds. This highly respected man may be worth paying a visit - a mighty steed can come in handy when you wander across Sarnaut's vast lands!
Greetings! Want to buy a mighty mount? A fast-legged Steed? Or maybe something more exotic?
Have a look. A good Steed is of use to anyone!
Talk to Vladimir Kostin to get a Courier's Steed.

Yes, I was warned.
So you need a Stallion to deliver something urgent? No-no! Don't tell me what it is!
The less you know, the better you sleep.
Tell me, when you are ready to go.

My horses won't let you down. They are the most reliable creatures!
I will give you a scroll allowing to summon a horse for a short time. Use it, then open your stables for summoning.
Talk to Vladimir Kostin, horseman in the Victory Park in Nezebgrad, straddle a horse and bring Wrokag's bag to Sino the Merciless on IMD Training Ground.

Wait a minute! I have a special order from Wrokag Severny, with Yasker's signature. "Help as much as you can!" Obviously, it's an important matter.
You must quickly bring this bag to IMD to some Sino the Merciless. You can find him on training ground. And you mustn't use portal. This bag should be protected from Astral and magical influence.
You have my approval on using a horse for this task. Run to the Triumphal Arch and find Vladimir Kostin, horseman. He is already warned. he will give you a horse. It will bring you to Sino rapidly.

Hm...
Wrokag promised to send a messenger. Did you forget about it?

Ah, here you are. Give me this sack. We need to refresh totems' charges...
Who do you like horse ride? Was it good enough? I hope they will present with such horse for good job. I will be an important Orc!
Get 20 meteorite fragments by completing quests given by Nikolai Promokashkin and bring them to Andrei Prorabin at the Nezebgrad dock.

Well, well.. Where on earth is this paper? Ah, here it is!
So, by decree number 2778\16-VP, the great Yasker grants anyone who has merited the title of Great Hero a right to acquire an allod of their own. Date, stamp, signature - all in place! There's a problem, though... We can use astralium to create an allod - thanks to you we've mastered the Master's technologies fairly well. But how can we keep the new allod from being absorbed by the Astral? Clearly, you won't find a Great Mage for each new allod! Therefore, meteorite iron is our only option. And as you might've guessed, it doesn't grow on trees.
That's why Yasker has ordered that meteorite fragments only be given to the heroes who prove themselves in trials. Sets of trials will be changed randomly every day, and you'll get a meteorite fragment for each one. Once you've collected 20 fragments, go to Andrei Prorabin at the dock. He'll get the construction of the new allod started.
Oh, I wish I had an allod of my own! I'd build a house with a porch, lay out a garden and breed fish in the pond... Sounds blissful!
Excellent. Now that you've managed to get enough meteorite fragments, I'll get the construction of your personal allod started.
Check on the allod construction progress, obtain 30 meteorite fragments by completing quests given by Nikolai Promokashkin, and bring them to Andrei Prorabin at the Nezebgrad dock.

So, let's get started. To begin with, we need to form the core of the future allod. Its heart, so to say! This is a very important process. A slightest mistake can make the whole allod fall apart!

We will need 30 meteorite shards, which you can obtain from Nikolai Promokashkin by completing his quests. As soon as you get enough, come to me, and we will continue working.
What can be more majestic than creating a brand new allod?
Excellent. Now we have enough meteorite iron to continue construction without running the risk of the Astral absorbing the results of our work!
Check on the allod construction progress, obtain 40 meteorite fragments by completing quests given by Nikolai Promokashkin, and bring them to Andrei Prorabin at the Nezebgrad dock.

We have completed the most important part. Now let's get down to more trivial tasks, like growing a block of ground on our gorgeous core. It's like building a sculpture at the Astral scale! Alright, I guess you don't need all the details.

We will need 40 meteorite shards, which you can obtain from Nikolai Promokashkin by completing his quests. As soon as you get enough, come to me, and we will continue working.
What can be more majestic than creating a brand new allod?
Very good! Now we can walk upon this lifeless land, which one day will become the best allod in Sarnaut!
Jungles? Hmm, why not? Not bad. Looks good, nice and green. So, shall we stick with the jungles, or take a look at some other options?

The whiteness of pure snow, the impregnability of gray stony precipices, blinding sun that makes your eyes water, and frost that nibbles at your ears. Each to their own! Shall we stick with the snow, or change to something else?

Check on the allod construction progress, select its future appearance, obtain 55 meteorite fragments by completing quests given by Nikolai Promokashkin, and bring them to Andrei Prorabin at the Nezebgrad dock.

It is about time you took part in the construction of your allod. You need to choose what it will look like. Choose wisely!

We will need 55 meteorite shards, which you can obtain from Nikolai Promokashkin by completing his quests. As soon as you get enough, come to me, and we will continue working.
What can be more majestic than creating a brand new allod?
A good choice! We'll see what we can do. Meanwhile, stay away from the construction site. It's way too dangerous right now.
Accept the work from Liza Yardstick, get 70 meteorite fragments by completing quests given by Nikolai Promokashkin, and bring them to Andrei Prorabin at the Nezebgrad dock.

Now it is the time for the final stage. Your land has been raw and unstable for too long; it's time for it to become a full-scale allod! Look at what Liza Yardstick has done - she's been working without cease!

We will need 70 meteorite shards, which you can obtain from Nikolai Promokashkin by completing his quests. We will use them to reinforce and decorate the allod.

Come back as soon as you get them, and we will finish the construction!
What can be more majestic than creating a brand new allod?
Finally, the construction of your allod is complete! You can go to your allod and gaze upon it in all its splendor!

Phew! That was the most interesting job in my life! Can you believe it - we've created a whole allod with our own hands! Thank you for this possibility. If you need some assistance in the future, do not hesitate to call on us!
Participate in battle on the Arena of Death and report to Nikolai Promokashkin on completion.
Participate in Deserted Farm, Witch's Hollow, Training Camp, Battle for Cargallas battleground, or play Goblinball and report to Nikolai Promokashkin on completion.
Defeat 20 Demons, an Octulhu, or another ancient monster in the Mysterious Astral and return to Nikolai Promokashkin.
Destroy the strongest enemy at any island in the Mysterious Astral and report to Nikolai Promokashkin.
Complete the trials in Tka-Rik's Cave and report to Klavdia Kalugina.
For each trial completed I will reward you with a meteorite fragment that will prevent your allod from dissolving in the Astral.
Well, the trial is complete. Here's your reward!
Raise the War Banner and destroy 30 monsters in the Kingdom of Elements, then return to Nikolai Promokashkin.
Acquire 15 Desire Incarnates on the Cradle and report to Nikolai Promokashkin on completion.
Bring Lodestone from the Boutique to Nikolai Promokashkin.
For each trial completed I will reward you with a meteorite fragment that will prevent your allod from dissolving in the Astral.
Well, the trial is complete. Here's your reward!
Earn 1 Silver Anniversary Coin and report to Nikolai Promokashkin on completion.
Help Radigost Ploughman fight rodents on Umoir and report to Nikolai Promokashkin.
Complete one of the Pledges to the Guild Master and report to Nikolai Promokashkin.
Complete one of the daily quests on Irdrich and report to Nikolai Promokashkin.
Complete one of the daily quests in the Illusory World and report to Nikolai Promokashkin.
Complete one of the daily quests on the Wandering Island and report to Nikolai Promokashkin.
Complete one of the daily quests on the Twilight Isle and report to Nikolai Promokashkin.
Complete one of the daily quests on Kirah and report to Nikolai Promokashkin.
Watch the formation of your allod and report to Nikolai Promokashkin.
Visit your allod, accept the work from Liza Yardstick, and report to Nikolai Promokashkin.
Participate in the Chariot race on Dionic Archipelago, the race on Kirah or the marathon on the Wandering Isle and report to Nikolai Promokashkin on completion.
Find one of the lost in time on Kirah and report to Nikolai Promokashkin.
Help kill 5 players in the Kingdom of Elements or 15 players in Skirmishes and report to Nikolai Promokashkin.

Those who achieve greatness, make great enemies, too. And your enemies are just countless! The League is our biggest threat at the moment. We should thin down their ranks, don't you think?

Help us put an end to several enemy lives in the Kingdom of Elements or in Skirmishes, and I will reward you with a meteorite fragment.
Deliver messages to the Servants of the Light and report to Nikolai Promokashkin.
Complete one of the daily quests on Ferris and report to Nikolai Promokashkin.
Ferris is full of mysteries and dangers. Here is your mission: help Surveyors on Ferris, whatever it is they want you to do. I will reward you with a Meteorite Fragment.
Destroy the strongest enemy in any Distortion and report to Nikolai Promokashkin.

Distortion is no place for the weak. When you get there, you will see the images of the past - or what it could have been like. You will see all the possible variations of the past events! And you will be the one who decides which one will define the present. A decent challenge for those who pursue Greatness!

Here's a trial for you. If you complete it, I'll reward you with a meteorite fragment. Go to any Distortion and destroy the toughest opponent in it.
Open a chest on the Melting Isle and report to Nikolai Promokashkin on completion.

Here's a trial for you. If you complete it, I'll reward you with a meteorite fragment. Open a chest on the Melting Isle. Keep in mind that other heroes may be working on the same quest, and they won't surrender the chest without a fight. Only the best of the best, the greatest of the Great will merit an allod of their own!
Defeat one of the powerful enemies in Ancient Mound, Eclipse, "Gates" Project, Fractal, Winter Palace, Battle of Gods, Observatory or Secret Paths. Report to Nikolai Promokashkin.
Give Nikolai Promokashkin 320 Emblems of Greatness and speak with Yasker about achieving greatness.

Now that your veins throb with the blood of dragons, there is no going back. Only onward, to new knowledge and power! From this day on, you must improve yourself every day, every instant. To stop is to die. The primordial flame that's in dragon blood will burn you up if it is unable to find outlet in battle or in the attainment of new knowledge.
But if you can tame the dragon flame that now burns within your heart, then you will become one of the Empire's greatest heroes, and your talents will open new frontiers for you. Of course, you'll never be a Great Mage. To subdue the astral and force it back will take more than a gulp of dragon blood, but in your particular field you will become great. Be you a great warrior, paladin or healer, the most important thing is that others see you as a role model, inspiring hope and service to the Empire. Believe me, this is worth a great deal, even without the true Great Mages' talent for restricting the astral to certain spaces and opening portals with the wave of a hand.
However, power goes hand in hand with avarice and pride. There's no room for such vices in the Empire, and I must test you once again. That's not a request, but an order! If you manage, good. If not... Better not think of that.
All I need from you are Emblems of Greatness. You earn them through feats of valor, and you can turn them in to comrade Promokashkin against receipt. Once you've collected the necessary amount, then we can talk about your promotion.
To stand out from the rest, hard work is a must. And you're no exception. But believe me, your efforts will not be in vain.

Well, then... Congratulations, hero! Now you can safely add "Great" to your list of titles! All the seals are in place and my signature is already drying on your certificate.
Now, a bit about controlling dragon flame. I said that you will have to practice every day, every hour if you want to improve, right? Well, your determination in receiving emblems and that truly superhuman willpower that you employed in order to carry out what was truly a tortuous task are all methods of self-improvement.
I hope you are coming to the proper conclusions and that you are not going to settle for what you've already accomplished. The universe is full of secrets waiting to be discovered!

Listen to me very carefully!
I've been watching you since you distinguished yourself by destroying the ship of our sworn enemies all on your own. And I'm placing big hopes on you. A great future lies ahead for you, provided you don't stray from the chosen path!
Don't get a big head, though. Everything in this world comes with a price tag. You will become a great Imperial hero... Or not - that all depends on you. The Empire will follow your every move, celebrate your victories and commiserate with your defeats. These are not just words! All your deeds, even the minor kind, will be recorded in your dossier.
Talk to the accountant Nikolai Promokashkin to find out more. Good luck!
Any questions? Feel free to ask them!
I hope you'll heed my words. Even if you can't find any use for these Emblems for now, trust me, they'll come in handy if you continue your progress!
Question Nikolai Promokashkin about exchanging amalgam.

Greetings, hero!
I want to tell you about one of the ways to get Emblems of Greatness.
Talk to me and I'll tell you everything in detail.
Listen to me carefully and focus on what I say.
All clear? Good. Best of luck!
Question the accountant about the trials in Tka-Rik's Cave.

Greetings, hero!
I want to tell you about one of the ways to get Emblems of Greatness.
Talk to me and I'll tell you everything in detail.
Listen to me carefully and focus on what I say.
All clear? Good. Best of luck!
Question Nikolai Promokashkin about exchanging staples for Emblems of Greatness.

Most likely, you will come across various staples in your travels. They will help you improve your equipment. Bear in mind that you can always exchange extra staples for Emblems of Greatness. I can tell you more if you wish.
That's one of the greatest constructions! How can I help you?
Thank you. We shall make good use of them. Nothing will be wasted!
Speak with Nikolai Promokashkin, then meet Andrei Prorabin at the Nezebgrad port.

Now that you're truly a Great Hero, you can create an allod of your own. This is a great honor that's only granted to the chosen ones! Truth be told, I envy you... Having your very own allod - imagine that! Alas, all I can do is lead the good fight against excessive bureaucracy. To each his own, I guess. Go see Andrei Prorabin, our best engineer, who will guide you through the creation of your allod. He's at the Nezebgrad port. Andrei will tell you all the particulars of allod creation. And visit the Bookkeeper on your way, he has something to tell you.
Want to learn more about creating new allods? OK, I'll try to tell it to you in brief without going into technical details.
Now your training has been completed. Accept my congratulations!
Get permission from three high-ranking officials of Nezebgrad and talk to Major of the Imperial Sentinels Oleg Pravdin.

Hm... Soon you have to go to Holy Land. There you will badly need good weapon. Otherwise... you are doomed!
Pity, that it takes long to get good weapon. Your can take a queue and wait. Long. Or you may go another way.
Some people who have done a lot to the Empire use to get the Ceremonial Dagger from Yasker's hands! You may get it also, if you win favor of high-ranking officials of Empire, who will sign the application about your priority of gaining it.
Remember those to whom you should speak.
Yuri Kavelin, Overseer of the Imperial Artisans. Yasskul Isis, the Research Institute director. And Oko the Righteous, Colonel of the Imperial Sentinels.
Everyone should give you a permission. When you have all three, return to me.

It is an honor to get the Ceremonial Dagger.
Imagine, you are walking in Nezebgrad and showing off. Everybody is smiling and waving to you. Because they know: only heroes can get such weapon.

Got all three permissions?
From one hand it's good news. From the other hand, it's ill news.
Let me explain.
Tame five cannibals on Wild Isles, having trapped them into a cage with the help of meat. Report to Yuri Kavelin, Overseer of the Imperial Artisans.

Do you want to get permission of the Imperial Artisans for obtaining Ceremonial Dagger? Then help!
Now we are working on the project of circumstance road near Nezebgrad. We plan to use the most innovative technologies.
However, even magic can't always help. Or there exist more efficient ways. Especially, when it comes to physical force, which is very necessary.
I'm speaking about cannibals living on Wild Isles. We would like to try and make them get used to ordinary food, tame them and use for construction works. You can try to help us. If you succeed, I'll give you my permission.
Listen, what you should do.
Go to Savage Isle and start hunting Warty Boars. Your task is to collect their meat. As much as you can. Trap hungry cannibals with the help of this meat to the cage.
There is our man. Vitaly Trapen, hunter. Talk to him, if you have questions.

As soon as we finish construction of circumstance road, we'll start a new project. Underground road!
League will envy!

The ogres have been already delivered to Nezebgrad. I should say it's easier to kill these creatures than feed them. But that is none of your concern.
Therefore, you have my permission.
Test the Suppressor on the orcs from the Fierce Clan on the Wild Isles. After each test talk to the pacified orc. You must talk to 4 pacified orcs. Report back to Yasskul Isis.

I might be able to help you with your problem.
If you help me first. Well?
Listen. I have several rather promising projects, but no time to work on them. One of them is about changing... Or rather, correcting wild orcs' nature. It is very difficult to control these creatures. As you understand, this is not good for Empire.
I will ask you to test the device to see if it can lower the aggression of the orcs living on the Wild Isles. I speak about the orcs of the Fierce Clan.
Use the Suppressor a few times, and then talk to the pacified orc. Ask how he is feeling. Before starting mass production of the Suppressor, we must consider all possible side affects.
There is also a chance that the Suppressor won't work. How would the orc react? I don't know yet. You'll have to find out for yourself.

If we solve the problem of wild eagles...
Hmph, Nezeb Award is bound to be granted to my branch!

I knew it!
Rage is the nature of orcs. Trying to suppress them, we turn them into stupid and lazy creatures. Does Empire need such creatures?
No.
Let's continue trying to solve this problem. Besides, the device is far from being perfect.
This is your permission. Thank you for help!
Hang 4 agitation posters of the Sentinels on Fierce Isle and report to Oko the Righteous, Colonel of the Imperial Sentinels.

Do you want to get permission for obtaining the Ceremonial Dagger?
Then fulfill my task.
We conduct the agitation work among orcs of Wild Isles. Call for joining us. However, they are not so eager to do it.
But it's ok. Water wears out stone. Sooner or later they will make the right choice. We should stop.
Is it clear what you have to do? Go to Wild Isles and stick few agitation posters on poles. First of all we are interested in the isle of Clan of Fierce. Then return to me with your permission.

The more orcs, the better.
I'm sure in it 100 percent!

Good job. I appreciate it.
I give you my permission like I promised.
Meet with Yasker and tell everything about getting permission.

Do you know already that fight against the corruption started?
Case under the personal control of Yasker."Don't use the official position for personal gain!" - That's what he said. And hit the table with his fist! This is a bad sign. Very bad.
Investigation is underway. And on Yasker's table is lists of those who received permission for a personal armor from secretary of Nezebgrad. There is your name as well. Want some advice? Go immediately to Yasker and tell him everything. If there are any sins - repent! Or than you will spend the rest of your life in Pridonsk!
Well? What do you have to tell me?

Yes, I saw your name on the list of corruption suspects.
Well, tell me everything. Don't hide anything from me!
Bring 3 important artifacts to Yasker from the Secret Laboratory.

Really?
So, all the tasks that you performed for these permissions were not personal! All for the benefit of the Empire...
 You know, this is very good. I'm glad I was mistaken in you and in the officials. All their thoughts were for the good of the Empire, and not about personal gain. Ah, with such subordinates, we can move the mountains!
But now because you do everything so successfully... I also give you instructions. Not personal, but for the state.
There is a place... Lab Thirteen. Maybe you've even heard something about it. Very important experiments are carried out there. However, they are now stopped.
Emergency happened in the Laboratory. All forces were thrown to deal with its consequences, and your help would be most welcome here.
You have to enter the lab and return three artifacts used by scientists. They are too valuable to leave them there. Look for them in the chests where scientists store their equipment.
To get to the Lab Thirteen, you must show this document to Rinat Mishin, Druid Mentor of Nezebgrad.
I hope your visit to the Secret Laboratory will be as successful as the Wild Islands campaign.

I believed in your success and ready for your triumphant return.
That's why this all was engaged. Your personal weapons. Choose what your soul prefers!
Make sure all dancers are ready and return to Father Winter.

So, how are you feeling? Festive? Good! That's exactly how you should feel. After all, Yasker ordered us to celebrate the New Year and that means having a good time!
We, the New Year Committee, are spending all our time creating this good mood. We have planned concerts, dances, and many public events to make sure this celebration is a success!
We are setting up a huge dancing event! To get everybody involved, I arranged Merry Dancers near the New Year tree, in the Victory Park, at the Old Square, at Izune, and at the Bort Quarter. Will you walk around the neighborhood and check if everybody is dancing alright. Let me know, if anyone fails to dance!
My job is to bring joy to the people, and your job is to help me do so!
Good job! All the dancing citizens will have you and other helpers to thank.
Throw 3 Snowballs and return to Father Winter.

An essential part of the New Year celebration is snow. Before the Great Cataclysm the winters here were short and mild, but it still snowed on occasion. Activities such as sledding and making fortresses of snow were incredibly popular.
Right now we have a whole team of mages that are tasked with making snow. It won't be enough to bring back the old days, but it is enough to create snowballs! Here, take three samples. You can toss them at your friends - purely for fun. Or you can throw snowballs at your enemies and defeat them before the snow wears off. Repeat it three times, and the holiday gift is yours!
There is also another way to receive the presents. If the New Year begins and people's hearts are only filled with greed, they will become corrupted like Greedy Father Winter. Then they will have only one goal - to ruin the holiday festivities! They'll run all over the city tearing down as many candy canes as possible. The only way to stop them is with snow!
If you need more snow, you can steal it from any snowmen you find!
So, did you have fun? Excellent! I'd advise you to enjoy the snowballs while the holiday season lasts!
Place 5 Holiday Trees, 5 Snowmen, and 5 Candy Canes around Nezebgrad and return to Father Winter.

The city is already full of snowmen, candy canes, and holiday trees... but it's still not enough! The New Year doesn't happen every other day!
Do you think you can help us out? Here, place these trees about the city so people can have more gifts! Set up the snowmen, too - they look fine, and people can grab more snowballs. Oh, and one more thing. Take these candy canes and place them all around! I know Greedy Fathers Winters just love tearing them down, but they're so beautiful!
Nezebgrad is already a beautiful city, but with some holiday decorations it can become even better!
Wonderful! The city looks amazing now, doesn't it?
Dance in three districts of Nezebgrad, fix three snowmen, give presents to three citizens and return to Father Winter.

Do you want to help organize the celebration? We’re always in need of volunteers.

First, we need the cheerleaders. Here's a rattler, play it and dance near fir trees at Imperial square and Old square near Yasker's Tower. The more dance, the more fun!

Second, the snowmen. Some evasive vandals always use them to make snowballs! Ah well, I guess, they can have their fun. And we have to fix the snowmen. Here's extra snow for your to fill in the holes.

Third, and the main thing, the gifts! Give them to three citizens on my behalf! Don’t worry, I’ll give one to you too!
Nezebgrad is the capital of our motherland, the most beautiful city in the world! Snowmen and garlands suit it very well in winter!
Look how beautiful our Nezebgrad is! Here is your present. Happy New Year!
Visit Zarida the Fierce in the Central Imperial Camp to learn a new Martyr's ability.

I have something very important to tell you about. Zarida the Fierce is a respected and experienced shaman. She's currently residing in Asee-Teph in the Central Imperial Camp.
In accordance with Yasker's recent decree, she's helping every Imperial citizen that wishes to learn a new Martyr's Guidance ability. With her help, our soldiers can become stronger and eventually crush the League! I urge you to meet with her for the good of the Empire!
It seems like the officials in Nezebgrad are doing their job! I'm glad that you found your way to me. It's extremely important that every Imperial citizen obtains the support of the Great Martyrs.
Visit Zosim Nikulin in western Eljune to find out about the Martyr's Protection ability.

Listen up. All those who want to reach the fourth level of patronage must go to the western area of the Holy Land known as Eljune. Along the coast there lives a great ascetic by the name of Zosim Nikulin who can help you with your quest.
He's a Kanian veteran of the Great Astral Campaign, and he's considered one of the most enlightened men alive. He is deeply opposed to the war between the League and the Empire, and so he helps anyone regardless of their race.
Because you can gain so much power from obtaining the Martyr's Protection ability, it's recommended that every citizen of the Empire do so. Make sure to follow his every instruction.
So you're interested in the fourth level of patronage, eh? Hm... Alright, I'll help you with your task.

Ask Andrei Prorabin to add the coordinates of your personal allod to the portal network, then either speak to any Portal Guardian or use your Adventurer's Stone to teleport to your allod and meet Bob Jackhammer.

Your allod is almost complete! We strengthened the surface with meteorite fragments and changed the landscape as you ordered. And now I'm happy to announce that from now on, a new island is entirely in your possession!  Just tell me when you are ready, and I will add your allod’s coordinates to the global teleportation map So you can travel to your domain using the Adventurer's Stone at any time.
This construction project is wearing me out...
So it's you, our new boss! Welcome! I'm the foreman here, they call me Bob Jackhammer. I'm supervising the construction of your tower!

Ask Andrei Prorabin to add the coordinates of your personal allod to the portal network, then either speak to any Portal Guardian or use your Adventurer's Stone to teleport to your allod and meet Bob Jackhammer.

Your allod is almost complete! We strengthened the surface with meteorite fragments and changed the landscape as you ordered. And now I'm happy to announce that from now on, a new island is entirely in your possession!  Just tell me when you are ready, and I will add your allod’s coordinates to the global teleportation map So you can travel to your domain using the Adventurer's Stone at any time.
This construction project is wearing me out...
So it's you, our new boss! Welcome! I'm the foreman here, they call me Bob Jackhammer. I'm supervising the construction of your tower!

Your allod is almost complete! We strengthened the surface with meteorite fragments and changed the landscape as you ordered. And now I'm happy to announce that from now on, a new island is entirely in your possession!  Just tell me when you are ready, and I will add your allod’s coordinates to the global teleportation map So you can travel to your domain using the Adventurer's Stone at any time.
This construction project is wearing me out...
So it's you, our new boss! Welcome! I'm the foreman here, they call me Bob Jackhammer. I'm supervising the construction of your tower!

Use the extractor on the corpses of slain enemies of at least 70th level to summon their energy bundles, then destroy these bundles to charge the vials containing the iridescence suspension. You'll need the energy of 30 Elementals, 30 humanoids, 30 beasts and 30 Architects, all killed by you on Ammr. Then go back to Sarbaz Losash and get a vial of chromatite from him.

Throughout the ages, the highest form of alchemy has always been the ability to produce amalgam from a solution based on an extremely rare component - the iridescence. It is a very complicated process, and many alchemists have lost their lives attempting to learn the secret of producing amalgam by alchemical means!
The problem is that the iridescence only reacts with chromatite, a very unstable substance that can explode at any moment. But that's only half the problem.
The hardest part is actually finding a iridescence! But you're not afraid of challenges, are you? Then take a magic extractor and a few vials filled with iridescence suspension, and transform it into a proper iridescence. To do that you'll need to kill a specific creature and absorb its lifeforce with the extractor. You'll need the energy of demons, beasts, elementals and humanoids. Creatures on Dane allod will do - the magialchemic environment there is just right!

Simply kill an enemy and wait for its energy bundle to appear, then defeat the bundle. For completing the quest you'll get some chromatite. Then all you need to do is mix the iridescence and the chromatite at a ratio of 4 to 1 in a mortar.
If everything is done correctly, you'll get drops of pure Amalgam as a result!
Once again we see that art requires sacrifice... Especially in the case of alchemy!

Did you manage to get a iridescence? Not a suspension, but a real iridescence, charged with the energy of fallen enemies? Excellent! Then take a flask of chromatite from my personal supplies. It is my gift to you, so be grateful! And try to not blow up the capital...
Speak with Sarbaz Losash In Yasker's Tower.

And who might you be? A warden? A scout? A psionicist?
The reason I'm asking... Well, they're the ones who use my services the most. Why? Because they wear leather clothing, of course! I ought to tell you that only we, the leatherworkers, know how to make something really special that you can't find in any store.
Have I piqued your curiosity? Then buy a training manual and tools from me. You won't regret it!
There's no rush to decide. I suppose you could be an alchemist... Sarbaz Losash, the best alchemist in Nezebgrad, is somewhere here in the Tower. Find him and ask him about his trade.

Do you want to talk about alchemy?
You got it! Everyone finds the science of potion-brewing interesting...
Speak with Hummer the Nimble in Yasker's Tower.

Alchemy... Can't live without it these days! If you want to defeat your enemy, you've got to quaff the right potion first! Need to heal your wounds? Stock up on the right jars. That's the way it is! Everyone comes to alchemists, they all need us...
Did I say "us"? Hmm, well you could become an alchemist... All you need to do is buy a training book and tools from me. It's your call.
Don't rush it though... You might find another profession more to your liking. Only you can make that decision though.
For information on another profession, you could talk to Hummer the Nimble - he's the blacksmithing trainer. He's here in the Tower, just like all the other masters.

Argh! I don't feel comfortable here... I need to get some fresh air!
Orders are orders though. I've got to teach clueless greenhorns the noble art of making armor.
Speak with the leader of the Imperial Crafters' Guild, Viktor Gvozdin, in Yasker's Tower.

So you want to become a blacksmith? Forge armor for warriors, healers, and paladins? Hmm... Ok, you can try. But I have to warn you... Many come to me saying they want to become a blacksmith, and I certainly tell them everything and explain the details, but not everyone can become a real master! It takes a lot of work. But then... masters get respect and a stable income. If you decide you want to do it, let me know. I'll sell you the right book and tools. Am I the last trainer you visited? After this you'll have to see Victor Gvozdin, the head of our Artisans' Guild. He's our supervisor. We get all of our instructions and orders from him. Tell him you've passed the course for a beginner craftsman.

Yes?! I am very busy! What is it? Oh, so you've visited the craftsmen of Nezebgrad? Let me note that down in my report... Good. If you join us, remember to come and see me now and again. I have plenty of orders for you.
Speak with Karim Shagrenin in Yasker's Tower.

We are the weavers of textiles, so supplying clothes to magicians and necromancers is our specialty! We use different fabrics to make mantles, headwear, gloves... In short, every kind of cloth armor one could need!
You can join us, all you need is to buy the training book and tools from me! If you aren't lazy, you'll go far in this profession. I'll give you a few tips and recipes, and soon they'll be praising your name all around the Empire. That sounds nice, doesn't it? And it's good for the state!
However, you can reach the same fame in another profession as well, like leatherworking. Somewhere around here is a colleague of mine named Karim Shagrenin who teaches citizens how to turn animal hides into clothing. Talk to him if you'd like to learn more about that.

Did Yana send you?
We're old friends. She makes cloth armor, and I leather. I can tell you more about leatherworking if you'd like.
Speak with Yana Beketova in Yasker's Tower.

Attention, attention!

New orders from Yasker.

"In order to improve the quality of the services provided and the goods produced, and thus disprove the dirty insinuations of the enemies of the Empire, I decree:
First: Hold an Exhibition of Achievements of the Imperial Economy (EAIE) in Nezebgrad. At this exhibition, the best craftsmen of the Empire will present their products, demonstrating the superiority of the Imperial crafts.
Second: I call on all conscientious citizens of the Empire to undergo training from the masters of Nezebgrad and become specialists in a craft of their choice.
Signed by Yasker."

There you go. You're a conscientious citizen, aren't you? Then I highly recommend visiting Yasker's Tower and talking to the trainers. You should start with Yana Beketova, she's a tailor.

But don't buy textbooks just yet. First speak with all the trainers. Then make your choice. Remember, you can learn only one profession! If you want another, you'll have to go to the Boutique or  get a license for the second profession, which is really hard to do.

However, if you already know which craft you want to learn, tell me about it, and I'll give you a task from the appropriate master. I'll also give you a proper manual and a tool - for a symbolic sum of 50 silver coins. It will cost you more than if you went directly to the masters, but the difference goes to the Empire's treasury.
Aha, a new member of our trade! You do want to talk about tailoring, right? I've always got time for that.
Talk to the weaponsmith trainer Aurora Bulatina.

So, you too want to become a blacksmith? Want to forge armor for warriors, healers and paladins? Hmm...
Well, give it a shot. I'll tell you what... Many tell me they want to be blacksmiths. Of course, I teach them and explain everything... Yet few will become true masters! That's for sure! That requires a lot of effort. But afterwards... You get respect and steady earnings.
And now you need to see Aurora Bulatina, she's the one who teaches weaponsmithing. That's a woman of steel! I wish she were an orc, I'd have married her, he-he! That's a joke - don't tell her I said that! Besides forging, she can use the hammer otherwise!

Want to work for the benefit of the Empire? That's good. Many are willing to brandish a sword or a magic wand, but no one wants to work with a hammer next to the furnace in a scorching shop. Become a weaponsmith, you won't regret it!

Listen carefully. I am now going to read you the commander's orders.
Ahem. The Imperial Army headquarters' decree number twenty-double zero-thirty!
For valor and heroism displayed in combat against superior enemy forces, for bravery in combat on enemy territory, as well as for the preservation of valuable scientific discoveries, the command staff issues the following proclamation: present the hero with the "Combat Glory" medal, present him with a week's leave and time in the rehabilitation program at the "Cloud Nine" Health Resort!
What else is there to say?
Stand firm, soldier! Glory to the Empire!

secrets: Science at the Service of the Empire

t: Talk to Pavel Nevolin in the Old Square.

Don't move a muscle! Are you aware that we're having problems with pollution in this area? That's why you have to pay for air! Breathing in will cost you one gold coin, breathing out costs ten.
I'll do you a favor this time and sell you a monthly pass. I suggest you get some gold together and pay the Black Hyenas or we'll give you some tough love alright. Go ask that beggar what happens to those who don't show respect to the Black Hyenas!

For Nezeb's sake, please spare some coins for food and medicine! I worked hard from dawn till dusk and got injured on the job! I gave up everything I had for the Empire! Please, spare some change!
Oh, Ryg sent you. Yes, he was the one who crippled me...
Kill 4 Black Hyena Assassins and 4 Black Hyena Raiders and return to Pavel Nevolin.

I refused to pay for a pass and look what they did to me... Now I sit here begging for money.
Not that I could use that money to get medicine for myself... the same Black Hyenas who crippled me rob me of any donations I get! They control this area - it's best that you pay them. Do that and you'll be able to roam the city freely, even in other areas which have their own gangs. That's life in the capital for you...
Then again... you can challenge them if you've got the guts for it. Pay them back for us weaker ones.
The Black Hyenas hang around in the slums. Go there and kill a few of them if you ain't scared. They'll respect you for it and they might even ease up on us weaklings too.
Now go! And for Nezeb's sake, please spare some coins for food and medicine for an injured worker!
So, you planning to challenge the Black Hyenas or are you ready to pay for your monthly pass?

I don't believe it... Wow! You really did it. Maybe I should quit begging and... give that Ryg something to think about!
But then, I wasn't blessed with strength... I guess I'll have to grin and bear it for now.
Kill "Slouch" Sokov and deliver Slouch's Head to Stepan Velikanin.

Attenshn citizens of the Empire! As you noticed, this aria is full of bandits. There leader Slouch seems impossible to get rid of. Someone is protecten him. He even gets his taxis payed!
Eniway, whoever kills Slouch and informs Stepan Velikanin, the cop captin, will get a big reward. Very big reward! Hurry! Death to the Black Hienas!

Maintaining order in the capital is not for the faint of heart. That's why I was appointed to the rank of commandant. I fear no one, make calm decisions in critical situations, and instill fear and reverence in my subordinates.

What?!
Slouch Sokov is dead? Who killed him? You?! Are you crazy?! What notice? I've never seen it before! I didn't write that trash!
Do you have any idea what's about to kick off here? Everyone and their dog will be fighting for control of this territory now, and it's all your fault, you moron!
How could you even think that the police would spell that badly? I graduated from the academy.
I know full well that "eniway" is spelled "enyway"!
Go see Pavel Bogdanov in the Bort Quarter.

Ugh, what a mess you've made here Imperial Survivor!
Yes, yes, of course I recognize you. The newspapers are full of stories about you these days. If it wasn't for that, I would love to teach you to not go reading signs and cutting people's heads off without permission!
Alright, listen to me. Go to the Bort Quarter and put your enthusiasm to good use over there. Pavel Bogdanov, the Head of Customs, was complaining to me about getting buried in problems. He even refused to go to the sauna with me yesterday, would you believe that?! It means things must be really hard now.
A friend must be rescued. Go and help him!

Are you the Imperial Survivor? Of course I've heard about you!
Stepan sent you here just in time, we've got a ton of things to do. Let's get started!
Kill 4 Magic Elementals near the mana station in Bort Quarter, then report to Roman Mishin.

Oh wait! Have you used any teleportation device on the ship? How did you get to the enemy ship? Through the boarding portal, right?
Hmm... There's another factor - the Astral! The magical substance!
Well, there's no problem getting some Astral in this town. Astral is supplied via the mana pipeline to mana stations in each district.
That's right! We, the great Xadaganian scientists, harnessed the Astral's power and put it to work for the Empire! The Zem helped a little... However, there are some minor safety issues to resolve... Some strange creatures have started appearing near the stations. Like elementals. I'm not surprised! It's a strong flow of magic, they must be drawn to it!
But we can take advantage of that now! Take your teleporter and head for the mana station in the Bort Quarter. The area around there is swarming with rogue magic elementals. Kill four of them. Then...
Then report to my colleague Roman Mishin. He'll help you make the final preparations needed to operate the teleporter.

I know this is going to work! Xadaganian scientists are the best!
I wonder if this discovery will earn me the State Prize... What I would give to see Sarang Tey green with envy!
Anyway, the time for that will come - right now I need to make the final adjustments to this teleporter!
Collect 3 Smuggler's Receipts from smugglers in the Underground Reservoir, then report to Pavel Bogdanov.

We're getting a real firework show every night. Just endless noise. I bet a new shipment of weapons has been delivered. How can we find out what the deal is? Maybe the smugglers kept some receipts...
That's why I need someone with brawn or powerful spells. The smugglers need to be searched. There are plenty of them at the underground reservoir. Which is really inconvenient. They dump everything into the water at the first sign of trouble. Also, a smuggler won't let you search him unless he's dead. Got it?
Rumor has it that there were 3 crates full of weapons. So there should be just as many receipts. Bring them to me.
Let's hope the smugglers keep their receipts on them. Oh, you didn't know? They keep better accounting records than we do!
A heap of receipts - perfect! Okay, let's see who delivered what to whom and where. Hmm... looks like this stuff originates from the Hadron Quarter, of all places.
Defeat 4 Bort Racketeers and return to Stanislav Karamzin.

Why hello there! I'm Stanislav, a merchant from Suslanger. I have recently arrived here by using the tele... telepor... well, you know the word I mean.
I was doin' fine, sellin' my wares across three villages, but when I finally drove Bogdan Pankov bankrupt, my folks started telling me - Stanislav, son, time for you to go to Nezebgrad. You're a big shot now, the city is yours for the taking! Right. So I came here.
But city folks ain't friendly for some reason. Don't wanna say hello, give me funny looks out o' the corners of their eyes... I've always tried to be friendly with everyone, but when I waved to some local guys here, they came up and started threatening me.
I'm afraid they wanna do me harm. Help me, please? Get those guys to leave me alone.
Oh, I get it! These people are thinking of robbing me, right?

Oh, thank you! You saved me! But I don't really wanna stick around here anymore. It's much more peaceful in Suslanger. How can I te... tele... teleport out of here? I'm gonna ask around about that...
Oh, I almost forgot, here's the coin I promised you. I'm gonna tell my mates about how you saved me. I'll let them know that there is someone in Nezebgrad who will give them a hand if they ever need it. See you around and thanks for everything!
Kill 4 Reservoir Adders in the Underground Reservoir and report to Yana Vezirova, the Guardian of the Second Nezeb Memorial near the Bort Quarter.

"... And long did the Xadaganian people wander the deserts, and long had their water skins been empty. At seeing this, the great Nezeb became dismayed and ordered for wells to be built to satisfy the thirst of the people. And so they dug wells where the camels struck the sand with their left hind legs, and where the last tears of dying infants fell on the scorching earth - but the waters would not flow. It was then that the great Nezeb opened his heart to sacred wisdom and sensed water in the depths of a wind-swept dune. Our people dug a well and water flowed freely onto the sands of the desert. The Xadaganian people then quenched their mighty thirst and built a city there. They named it Nezebgrad after their great leader. And they built the great gates."
To connect with Nezeb's experience, pilgrims must enter the water. However, this alone is not enough - they have to fight for it. That well does not exist anymore - many years have passed since those times. However, we do have an underground reservoir. Descend into the depths and kill four of the snakes that live there. In the name of Nezeb!
The underground reservoir is a very important part of the city, filled with life-giving water. It's a sacred place!

Are you done with the snakes? Nice job! Now do you understand what the second feat is about? Visit all five memorials, and you'll become a citizen of the Empire! Go see Agata Mestina at the Hadron Quarter.
Find 3 Titanium Screws in the Underground Reservoir and return to Yaver Mbizi at the Bort Quarter.

You know that creatures have arms made of bones, muscles, and tendons, all dressed up in a flashy covering of skin.
But what's the use? What's the use if they break and tear so easily?
We Arisen, on the other hand, have much more practical arms made of sturdy metal. There's just one catch - they won't hold together properly without titanium screws! I ordered a whole crate of them, waited for a whole month, and even held back the workers' pay just to be able to buy them. And for what? All it takes is one simpleton to accidentally drop them into the reservoir to ruin my plans.
If it were up to me, I'd chop his clumsy hands off and his dumb head to boot! What are you standing around for with that look on your face? Go down into the reservoir and bring me back those screws!
Do you have the titanium screws?

Screws! My screws! My heart would have skipped a beat just now if it beat at all!
Listen, how would you feel about working at the reservoir? No? That's a pity! Well, here's your reward.
Collect 3 contraband samples for Pavel Bogdanov.

A rather confidential matter has arisen. The police searched a house and discovered, among other things, a page from a certain magazine - a League magazine!
The page showed a female Elf! But that wasn't the half of it! She was... you know... in her birthday suit! That's right! The Orcs love that kind of thing, as you'd expect from uneducated barbarians!
No, I can't show you the page - my superiors confiscated it for their investigation. Our job is simple - catch the smugglers who are muddying the waters with this filth. It is said that they have a warehouse near the underground reservoir. Find the warehouse and bring me three samples of this contraband.
Yet another problem for me to deal with! Smuggled weapons and clothes I can handle. But books, magazines - this level of mischief is unprecedented!

I have already informed the authorities about the success of the operation while you were collecting evidence. They will pick up the material evidence tomorrow. I haven't looked at it yet...
I mean, my wife asked me to copy one of the patterns. Just don't tell anyone!
Meet Ivan Korystin at the Hadron Quarter.

Oleg Pravdin himself responded to my report! He also mentioned you. Listen:

"Thank you for your vigilance..." No, not that...

"The Empire is proud..." That's about me again...

Ah, here: "Send the surviving Imperial soldier to Ivan Korystin in Hadron Quarter with a copy of the report. Immediately." Well, it says "immediately", so you better hurry.
Pravdin sent you, right? To help? Good, we need all the help we can get.
Deliver Kazakova's Report to Yasskul Isis, the Head of the ZIT Branch in Nezebgrad.

Well, here's the finished report. We've done well, both of us!
Please take this to the branch of the ZIT Research Institute that's located in Nezebgrad. It's in the Hadron Quarter. What does ZIT stand for? It's the Zem Institute of Technology.
The Institute is where some of the best scientific minds of the Empire are nurtured. Even though it was founded by the undead who still control most of the activities, I have nothing but good memories of my time there. Perhaps you'll get to visit it someday.
Give this report directly to the head of the branch. Her name is Yasskul Isis, and she's a very nice lady, as you'll see. If only she had skin... Hehe...

I hope you're distracting me from my business only on a matter of extreme importance? Who are you?
The Survivor? Never heard of you! No, I don't read the Empire newspapers very often.

Let me have a quick look at that report. So... the teleporter's secret has been discovered. Great!
It wasn't discovered by Zem engineers?! Shocking!
Nonetheless, you deserve a reward from the whole of the scientific community.
Place 3 Black Hyena Emblems around the First Nezeb Memorial for Stepan Velikanin.

I'm gonna find out who wrote that monstrous notice pretending to be me. All of my other business is going on the backburner until whoever is responsible for this pays! I've got one more thing to worry about though...
Nobody in the area can know about Slouch's death. You caused this problem, so you'll have to deal with it! I had a pack of Black Hyena emblems around here somewhere... Let me find them... They opened up a secret printing shop last week... Here they are!
Post them on the street lamps around the Nezeb Memorial to create the appearance of gang activity. The last thing we want is gangs from other areas finding out Slouch is gone and fighting over this territory!
Your registration please! Oh, sorry, it's you. Have you posted the emblems?

Good, good. My agents have already informed me that Kostlyavy's bandits have been spotted in our area. The bastards thought they found easy pickings but now that they've seen the emblems they'll go back to the dump they crawled out of. Let them rot in their hole... far away from here!
Plant 3 Bugs into the flowerbeds by the buildings of the Hadron Quarter. Report to Ivan Korystin.

Something is going on in the Hadron Quarter. You know that joke that says that the Institute's walls are made of microconcrete because they're ten percent concrete and ninety percent microphones? A joke's a joke but there's some truth to it.
Until recently, we monitored conversations between scientists by using special bugs. These small insects crawl into cracks, settle down, and listen. Then mentalists somewhere in Yasker's Tower attune themselves so they can read the bugs' brain waves. You get the picture?
Why "until recently"? Well, because the bugs went quiet all of a sudden! Every last one of them! That's no coincidence! We'll find out who is responsible soon enough, but what we really need to do is regain control of the situation.
Our course of action will revolve around this box of bugs. Take it to the Hadron Quarter and release them into the flowerbeds. Don't put them all in the same place, though. Make sure to spread them throughout the area to increase the coverage. Understood?
So? Did the thing with the bugs go alright?
I know that you did a good job! How? We've already intercepted several important conversations!
Meet Ivan Korystin at the Hadron Quarter.

One of our agents reported that someone in the Hadron Quarter have possibly helped the smugglers... These scientists are always up to something! Find our agent at the Hadron Quarter for further instructions.
Did Pravdin send you? Alright, listen to me.
Search the Zem Tombs and find 3 Arisen Recruits and report back to Yasskul Isis.

We're working on many other projects besides Project Salvation. Any assistance you could provide with those would be useful.
Our main project is called "Awakening". For a long time, we've been excavating an ancient burial ground of the Zem people right here in the Hadron Quarter. Who are the Zem people, you say?! They are what the Arisen were known as before they died.
Unfortunately, most of the people are followers of Tep. He was a deranged leader who split the Zem people into different factions thousands of years ago. When they come back from the dead they become quite aggressive not just to us, their fellow countrymen, but to all living creatures.
Your task is to go to this dig site and find as many buried Zem as possible. Hopefully some of them will join the ranks of the Empire instead of following Tep. You can use this special instrument to help you - it's called the "Zem Detector". Be careful - the followers of Tep could be anywhere!
How are things going in the dig site?
Well it looks like you still got the job done! That's what happens when courage and perseverance are combined with the latest achievements of science and magic. Here, enjoy your hard-earned reward!
Eliminate 4 Skeletal Guardians and Skeletal Augurs in the Zem Tombs, then report back to Agata Mestina, the Guardian of the Third Nezeb Memorial.

"... And when the Xadaganian people finally escaped the barren desert, their souls danced with joy. But this joy was short-lived, for all of the fruitful lands were already home to the Kanians. The greed of the Kanians prevented the Xadaganian people from building their own cities and plowing their own fields. The Kanians dreamt only of sending their fellow humans back to the desert to be eaten by jackals. And it was then that the Great Nezeb opened his heart to righteous justice and fought the malevolent Kanians. Their cries were heard throughout the fields and forests as they fled in humiliation. And so the Xadaganians built their cities and began their ascent towards greatness."

Tthe Kanians are represented by the undead that the Tep's cultists raised in the nearby catacombs. At least those monsters turned out be good for something!
You should be lucky we're not forcing pilgrims to go to Kania and kill those unbelievers. The most important thing, of course, is the symbolism and the lesson that this trial teaches you!

You have completed your pilgrimage!

When the time comes for you to fight the League, remember Nezeb's heroic act. May your actions be worthy of his glory! Now go see Ekaterina Ordina in Izune.
Collect 3 Imperial Soldier's Medallions and return them to Lev Ragulin.

Each soldier of the Empire wears a medallion blessed by the Trinity Church. These beacons of light must not be lost to the darkness.
We have three warriors unaccounted for since the day those damn cultists appeared. They occupied the Dusty Catacombs - the entrance is in the middle of the dig site. They used the magic of death to flood the catacombs with the undead. Most of the men we sent there were slaughtered.
Retrieve their missing medallions from the cultists. May the Light be with you!

Alas, casualties are the inevitable consequence of war. But even worse than casualties on the battlefield are losses right here in the heart of our great Empire! Your assistance in returning peace to our great city will not be forgotten.
Thank you for your help. Each of these medallions represents the life of a soldier and the tears of his widow. Their sacrifices shall not be forgotten!
Collect 3 samples of Predatory Mold for the laboratory assistant Yaver Penicill at the Hadron Quarter.

While I was wandering around the catacombs beneath the Hadron Quarter I got really dirty. I was covered with spider webs, mud, and some sort of mold that managed to cover most of my lab coat. By the time I got back I was so tired I simply threw my coat onto the dissecting table and went to bed.
I couldn't believe my eyes in the morning! The day before I had been studying septic wounds and there was a fresh corpse on the table, covered with infested sores. The mold had covered the whole body and when I cleaned it off, the wounds were completely disinfected and just clean, bluish cuts remained. It turns out the mold destroys bacteria, can you believe that?
Just as I was getting ready to collect specimens for serious research, the cultists showed up in the catacombs! I'm no warrior, so I can't go back there! That's why I need your help - bring me samples of this mold and I'll dedicate my dissertation to you. Deal?
So? Tell me, quick! Did you find any of the mold in the catacombs?

Wow! That's just what I needed! If my suspicions are correct, I'll be able to make some exceptional medicine out of this mold! Then I can put an end to gangrene.
I need to think of a name for this stuff. Naming it after you would sound terrible... so maybe I should use my own name? Penicill's mold? Penicillin? What do you think of that?

secrets: Science at the Service of the Empire

t: Take the Smuggler's Letter to Ivan Korystin at the Hadron Quarter.

A piece of paper. The piece of paper is filled with familiar letters.
The message is impossible to understand due to heavy slang being used. You should probably show it to someone from the City Council.
What?! A letter? Let me see that...
Hmm... Curious. We should give these scribbles to our decoders - they'll sort it out.
Meet with Bree the Unseen In Izune.

We managed to record a very interesting conversation between two scientists. They were whispering very quietly, but fortunately they chose to stand right next to a plant where one of our bugs was concealed. It appears that there's no widespread conspiracy within the Research Institute - they're just common criminals operating on their own. However, it is still a matter of great importance.
They were discussing a shipment of contraband weapons being sent to Fiercetusk the Roughneck's gang in Izune. It appears they're aiming to gain complete control of the city.
You need to go there and meet our contact, a goblin named Bree the Unseen. The secret phrase you'll use to identify yourself is "We're both equally unkempt today" and his response should be "The verdict is final and may not be appealed". Don't ask - it's Bree's idea and he's very proud of it too.
Oh, one more thing - if the meeting is compromised, our contact will put three bison skulls in a nearby window. That's also Bree's idea. If you see the skulls, cover your tracks and get back here as soon as you can. That's it! Good luck - you'll need it.
Two, just two skulls and I barely managed to get them too!
I'm unkempt? I don't think so! I even combed my hair today. Oh, wait! I see what you mean... Err... the verdict is final and... hmm... may not be... appealed!
